body.title: The diff review is attributed per commit
body.summary: Thread storyKey through assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding from both callers (src/daemon/code-review-rpc.ts:146, src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/handler.ts:401) into realDiffGroundingDeps.rangeDiff (src/workflow/code-review/grounding.ts:430-433); with 'story-trailer' attribution storyRangeDiff (:363-393) builds every path's hunks from the kept units' own diffs; the diff grounding returns changeSetAttribution and sharedWithExcluded, which replace the subject's with its changedFiles.
acceptanceChecks: A diff review of a trailered Story shows only its own hunks, also in a file another Story edited in the same window.
Without storyKey the diff is today's.
Both diff callers record the attribution on the subject.
